claims: Old Dominion University (ODU) is a public research university.
Old Dominion University (ODU) is located in Norfolk, Virginia.
Old Dominion University (ODU)'s campus is situated in the coastal Hampton Roads region.
Old Dominion University (ODU)'s campus is positioned along Hampton Boulevard.
Old Dominion University (ODU)'s campus lies near the Naval Station Norfolk.
Old Dominion University (ODU) has additional campus centers located in Virginia Beach, Portsmouth, and Hampton.
Old Dominion University (ODU) has an urban campus.
